summary: Delek US Holdings filed an 8-K reporting the closing of Amendment No. 1 to its Amended and Restated Term Loan Credit Agreement. The amendment refinances the existing term loan, reducing outstanding principal to $850 million, extending maturity to six years post-closing, and lowering the interest rate to term SOFR plus 300 bps or base rate plus 200 bps. The credit facility is guaranteed by domestic subsidiaries (excluding Delek MLP entities) and secured by a first and second priority lien on specified collateral. This is a routine refinancing—not a special situation. Watch for compliance with customary covenants.
